selection: hash(stream-gate-v1|UID), 8 per normal segment/protocol; 16 per attack role; no scores read
real_scan: Complete raw scan for clock/resource census, selected endpoints for brute-force parity, no encoder/head evaluation
clock: c_i=max(c_(i-1),raw_timestamp_i); logical segment reset; all physical frames advance clock
window: j<=i AND c_i-W<c_j<=c_i; inbound target/protocol only; current included
freeze_after: All stream/resource gates PASS and scheduler COMPLETED 0:0; freeze specification only
storage: all arrays, checkpoints and raw data stay HPC; return summaries and SHA
